prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["System Tray Controls", "Your companion lives in your system tray. Click the tray icon to summon, hide, or adjust pet settings anytime.", "Got It"]
1: ["Meet Your Virtual Buddy", "Choose a companion path to customize a desktop pet tailored to your daily routine.", "Continue"]
2: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion profile is registered and ready for desktop deployment.", "Verified Desktop Pet"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "Bring your computer to life with a pet that responds to your workspace activities."]
4: ["Signing in secures your companion profile and prevents pet progress reset."]
5: ["Generating 3D assets and desktop rendering models..."]
6: ["Select Your Companion Archetype", "Pick the companion dynamic that best matches your work style."]
7: ["Your pet operates in the background. Click the taskbar icon anytime to bring it to the foreground."]
8: ["Generating Your Desktop Pet", "Feel free to work on other tasks. We will alert you when your pet is ready."]
9: ["Your Companion Is Ready!", "Start Desktop Companion"]
